name: Can I install a tubular skylight in a room without attic access?
description: Installation in rooms without attic access is possible but more complex, potentially requiring specialized tubing or intricate routing.

mainEntity.name: Can I install a tubular skylight in a room without attic access?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a tubular skylight in a room without traditional attic access, such as a cathedral ceiling or a multi-story home with limited space between floors, can be more complex but is often still possible. In such cases, specialized flexible or shorter rigid tubing might be used, or the installation may require more intricate routing. We assess the structural conditions during our consultation to determine the most effective and least invasive installation method for your specific home.
